summary: Defines extensions to the sockets API for the Host Identity Protocol. They focus on public-key identifiers found through DNS and also provide ways to bind Host Identity Tags to locators manually. Applications can also support relaxed security models where communication need not use HIP. Experimental.

eli5.summary: Instead of calling a computer by its address, HIP calls it by a special name that proves who it is. This lets programs use those names through the usual network programming tools.
